summary: Health assessment based on static analysis of Python modules and configuration files with focus on maintainability, security, reliability, and testability.

hotspots.reason: Moderate complexity with several imports and potential unhandled exceptions

provenance.evidence: try-except blocks present but some edge cases may be missing

hotspots.reason: Critical deployment logic with limited error handling and logging

provenance.evidence: Sparse logging and error handling in deployment methods

hotspots.reason: Lack of explicit test files found for some agent modules

provenance.evidence: Audit references but no direct test files for all modules

risks.title: Insufficient test coverage
risks.description: Some agent modules lack comprehensive unit tests, increasing risk of regressions during modernization.

risks.title: Inconsistent error handling
risks.description: Error handling is inconsistent across modules, potentially causing silent failures or poor observability.

risks.title: Sparse logging in critical modules
risks.description: Modules responsible for deployment and system intelligence have sparse logging, hindering troubleshooting.
